--abort-on-priority-when-disabled.help: If set, abort requests that specify a priority when priority scheduling is disabled.

--admin-api-key.help: Set admin API key for sensitive management endpoints (e.g. /hicache/storage-backend/clear). When set, admin endpoints require this key and do NOT accept --api-key.

--allow-auto-truncate.help: Allow automatically truncating requests that exceed the maximum input length instead of returning an error.

--allowed-media-domains.help: Restrict client-supplied HTTP(S) image, video, and audio URLs to these exact hostnames. Redirect destinations are checked against the same allowlist. When unset, remote media from any domain is allowed.

--api-key.help: Set API key of the server. It is also used in the OpenAI API compatible server.

--asr-max-buffer-seconds.help: Maximum seconds of PCM audio the streaming ASR WebSocket handler will accumulate before closing the session with a buffer_overflow error. Guards against OOM when a client streams audio faster than inference can consume it. Default 60s.

--asr-max-concurrent-sessions.help: Maximum number of concurrent realtime ASR WebSocket sessions served by /v1/realtime. New connections beyond this cap are accepted, sent an error{code:too_many_sessions} frame, and closed. Default 32.

--attention-backend.help: Choose the kernels for attention layers.

--attn-dp-size.help: The attention data parallelism size: the number of data-parallel attention groups inside the TP group, one scheduler each, while the FFN stays tensor parallel.

--base-gpu-id.help: The base GPU ID to start allocating GPUs from. Useful when running multiple instances on the same machine.

--batch-notify-size.help: Number of streaming notifications to batch before yielding to the event loop. Reduces asyncio wakeup overhead under high concurrency.

--bf16-gemm-backend.help: Choose the backend for unquantized BF16 GEMM operations. Options: 'auto' (default; selects 'cutedsl' on SM10x GPUs, except deterministic inference selects 'torch'; otherwise uses cuBLAS via torch.nn.functional.linear), 'cutedsl' (SGLang ...

--boundary-reduction.help: Select FFN boundary reduction: ar uses all-reduce then token redistribution; rs and rsv permit fixed-size and variable-size reduce-scatter respectively; rs+rsv permits both (RSv first). Unsupported paths fall back to ar. The option appli...

--bucket-e2e-request-latency.help: The buckets of end-to-end request latency, specified as a list of floats.

--bucket-inter-token-latency.help: The buckets of inter-token latency, specified as a list of floats.

--bucket-time-to-first-token.help: The buckets of time to first token, specified as a list of floats.

--c128-page-size.help: The physical page size of the NPU DSV4 C128 KV cache. Must be a positive multiple of 16.

--chat-template.help: The buliltin chat template name or the path of the chat template file. This is only used for OpenAI-compatible API server.

--checkpoint-engine-wait-weights-before-.help: If set, the server will wait for initial weights to be loaded via checkpoint-engine or other update methods before serving inference requests.

--chunked-prefill-size.help: The maximum number of tokens in a chunk for the chunked prefill. Setting this to -1 means disabling chunked prefill.

--completion-template.help: The buliltin completion template name or the path of the completion template file. This is only used for OpenAI-compatible API server. only for code completion currently.

--config.help: Read CLI options from a config file. Must be a YAML file with configuration options.

--constrained-json-disable-any-whitespac.help: (xgrammar and llguidance backends only) Enforce compact representation in JSON constrained output.

--constrained-json-max-whitespace-cnt.help: (xgrammar backend only) Max consecutive whitespace chars allowed in JSON constrained output. None means unbounded.

--constrained-json-whitespace-pattern.help: (outlines and llguidance backends only) Regex pattern for syntactic whitespaces allowed in JSON constrained output. For example, to allow the model generate consecutive whitespaces, set the pattern to [ ]*

--cp-strategy.help: Sharding strategy for prefill CP. 'zigzag' assigns each rank one early and one late sequence block; 'interleave' assigns token indices modulo the CP size.

--cpu-offload-gb.help: How many GBs of RAM to reserve for CPU offloading.

--crash-dump-folder.help: Folder path to dump requests from the last 5 min before a crash (if any). If not specified, crash dumping is disabled.

--cuda-graph-backend-decode.help: Backend for the decode phase. Folds into cuda_graph_config[decode].backend.

--cuda-graph-backend-prefill.help: Backend for the prefill phase. Folds into cuda_graph_config[prefill].backend.

--cuda-graph-bs-decode.help: Explicit list of batch sizes to capture for the decode cuda graph.

--cuda-graph-bs-prefill.help: Explicit list of batch sizes to capture for the prefill cuda graph.

--cuda-graph-config.help: Per-phase CUDA graph settings as JSON, e.g. '{"decode":{"backend":"full","max_bs":256},"prefill":{"backend":"breakable"}}'. Allowed backends per phase: full, breakable, disabled. JSON wins over the per-phase --cuda-graph-* convenience fl...

--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode.help: Maximum batch size captured for the decode cuda graph.

--cuda-graph-max-bs-prefill.help: Maximum batch size captured for the prefill cuda graph.

--cuda-graph-max-seq-len-prefill.help: Longest sequence a prefill cuda graph replay admits; longer batches run eager prefill. Folds into cuda_graph_config[prefill].max_seq_len.

--custom-weight-loader.help: The custom dataloader which used to update the model. Should be set with a valid import path, such as my_package.weight_load_func

--dcp-comm-backend.help: Communication backend for the decode context-parallel (DCP) attention reduction: 'ag_rs' (AllGather + ReduceScatter), 'a2a' (one All-to-All exchange of output+LSE, then a local LSE combine), or 'fi_a2a' (FlashInfer MNNVL All-to-All kerne...

--dcp-replicate-q-proj.help: For MLA decode context parallelism with the a2a/fi_a2a backend: replicate the Q projection so each DCP rank computes the full-head query locally (redundant projection compute), eliminating the per-layer head-dim all-gather of Q. Trades a...

--debug-cuda-graph.help: Enable debug/eager mode for CUDA graph using breakable CUDA graph. When enabled, graph breaks are inserted so every operation runs eagerly while still going through the CUDA graph capture / replay path. Useful for debugging CUDA graph ca...

--debug-tensor-dump-input-file.help: The input filename for dumping tensors

--debug-tensor-dump-layers.help: The layer ids to dump. Dump all layers if not specified.

--debug-tensor-dump-output-folder.help: The output folder for dumping tensors. In Eagle mode, tensor outputs from draft and target models are stored in separate subdirectories ('draft' and 'target').

--decode-attention-backend.help: Choose the kernels for decode attention layers (have priority over --attention-backend).

--decode-log-interval.help: The log and metrics reporting interval (in decode iterations) for decode batches.

--decoupled-spec-bind-endpoint.help: ZMQ endpoint this engine binds for its inbound channel in decoupled speculative decoding (verifier: result PULL; drafter: control PULL).

--decoupled-spec-connect-endpoints.help: Peer inbound (bind) endpoints to connect to, ordered by peer rank, for decoupled speculative decoding.

--decoupled-spec-rank.help: This engine's rank within its own role space (verifier-rank or drafter-rank) for decoupled speculative decoding.

--decoupled-spec-role.help: Role in decoupled speculative decoding: 'null' disables it, 'verifier' runs the target/verify half, 'drafter' runs the draft half.

--decrypted-config-file.help: The path of the decrypted config file.

--decrypted-draft-config-file.help: The path of the decrypted draft config file.

--deepep-config.help: Tuned DeepEP config suitable for your own cluster. It can be either a string with JSON content or a file path.

--deepep-mode.help: Select the mode when enable DeepEP or MoriEP MoE, could be `normal`, `low_latency` or `auto`. Default is `auto`, which means `low_latency` for decode batch and `normal` for prefill batch.

--deepep-v2-mode.help: DeepEP v2 ElasticBuffer communication topology, fixed at server init: `direct` (single-node NVLink) or `hybrid` (multi-node scale-out). Layout/grouped-GEMM and the decode CUDA graph are chosen per batch by inference phase, independent of...

--default-chat-template-kwargs.help: Default chat template kwargs applied to every request when not overridden per-request. Keys must match what the model's chat template expects (e.g. enable_thinking, thinking, reasoning_effort). Per-request chat_template_kwargs takes prec...

--default-priority-value.help: Default priority for requests without explicit priority.

--delete-ckpt-after-loading.help: Delete the model checkpoint after loading the model.

--detokenizer-worker-num.help: The worker num of the detokenizer manager.

--device.help: The device to use ('cuda', 'xpu', 'hpu', 'npu', 'cpu', 'musa'). Defaults to auto-detection if not specified.

--disable-aiter-allreduce-fusion-in-deco.help: Disable Aiter AllReduce Fusion for decode batches (DECODE / TARGET_VERIFY / draft-extend / IDLE) while keeping it for prefill. Only meaningful with --enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion.

--disable-aiter-allreduce-fusion-in-pref.help: Disable Aiter AllReduce Fusion for prefill batches (EXTEND / MIXED / SPLIT_PREFILL) while keeping it for decode. Only meaningful with --enable-aiter-allreduce-fusion.

--disable-attn-tp-gather.help: Disable scheduler-side attn_tp_gather (the upstream SP path that pads num_tokens to attn_tp_size and pre-allocates a gathered buffer). Use for models that manage SP scatter/gather at the model level (e.g., perform their own all_gather/re...

--disable-chunked-prefix-cache.help: Disable chunked prefix cache feature for deepseek, which should save overhead for short sequences.

--disable-cuda-graph-padding.help: Disable cuda graph when padding is needed. Still uses cuda graph when padding is not needed.

--disable-custom-all-reduce.help: Disable the custom all-reduce kernel and fall back to NCCL.

--disable-decode-cuda-graph.help: Disable the decode-phase CUDA graph. Convenience for --cuda-graph-backend-decode=disabled.

--disable-flashinfer-cutlass-moe-fp4-all.help: Disables quantize before all-gather for flashinfer cutlass moe.

--disable-hybrid-swa-memory.help: Disable the hybrid SWA memory pool.

--disable-outlines-disk-cache.help: Disable disk cache of outlines to avoid possible crashes related to file system or high concurrency.

--disable-overlap-schedule.help: Disable the overlap scheduler, which overlaps the CPU scheduler with GPU model worker.

--disable-prefill-cuda-graph.help: Disable the prefill-phase CUDA graph. Convenience for --cuda-graph-backend-prefill=disabled.

--disable-shared-experts-fusion.help: Disable the built-in shared experts fusion optimization for DeepSeek V3/R1. Note: Waterfill (--enable-waterfill) routes the shared expert as an extra MoE slot, so the shared expert is not separated from the MoE path when Waterfill is ena...

--disable-tokenizer-batch-decode.help: Disable batch decoding when decoding multiple completions.

--disaggregation-bootstrap-port.help: Bootstrap server port on the prefill server. Default is 8998.

--disaggregation-decode-allocation-polic.help: When to reserve per-request decode KV in disaggregated serving. prefill_complete retains KV on prefill until prefill finishes, then admits it on decode. Set the same policy on both roles. Default: early.

--disaggregation-decode-enable-offload-k.help: Enable async KV cache offloading on decode server (PD mode).

--disaggregation-decode-enable-radix-cac.help: Enable radix cache on decode server (PD mode). Caches KV prefixes to avoid redundant transfers. Incompatible with --enable-hisparse, speculative decoding, and --disaggregation-transfer-backend fake.

--disaggregation-decode-extra-slots.help: Number of extra decode req_to_token slots pre-allocated for in-transfer requests (PD mode). If unset, defaults to 0 (or 2x the per-worker running batch for small batches).

--disaggregation-decode-host-receive-thr.help: Device token usage fraction at which incoming KV is received in the decode retraction host pool, excluding evictable cache pages. Range [0, 1]; 1 disables host receive (default), 0 always uses host receive. Size with --hicache-size or --...

--disaggregation-decode-polling-interval.help: The interval to poll requests in decode server. Can be set to >1 to reduce the overhead of this.

--disaggregation-decode-retraction-backu.help: Storage backend for KV preserved across PD decode retraction. 'cpu_tensor' uses per-request CPU tensors. 'host_pool' uses a reserved HiCache pool and does not fall back on exhaustion. 'none' keeps no backup: a retracted request is aborte...

--disaggregation-enable-kv-checksum.help: Compute an Adler-32 checksum over each request's KV pages on prefill and verify it on decode. Enable on both prefill and decode engines. A mismatch aborts the request, or raises in CI. Disabled by default.

--disaggregation-ib-device.help: The InfiniBand devices for disaggregation transfer. Supports a single device (e.g., --disaggregation-ib-device mlx5_0), a shared comma-separated list (e.g., --disaggregation-ib-device mlx5_0,mlx5_1), a per-GPU JSON mapping (e.g., --disag...

--disaggregation-mode.help: Only used for PD disaggregation. "prefill" for prefill-only server, and "decode" for decode-only server. If not specified, it is not PD disaggregated

--disaggregation-transfer-backend.help: The backend for disaggregation transfer. Default is mooncake.

--dist-init-addr.help: The host address for initializing distributed backend (e.g., `192.168.0.2:25000`).

--dllm-algorithm.help: The diffusion LLM algorithm, such as LowConfidence.

--dllm-algorithm-config.help: The diffusion LLM algorithm configurations. Must be a YAML file.

--dllm-fdfo.help: Enable First-Done-First-Out (FDFO) scheduling for diffusion LLM inference. Enabled by default; use --no-dllm-fdfo to fall back to synchronous block scheduling.

--dp-size.help: The number of data-parallel replicas of the model.

--dsa-decode-backend.help: DSA (DeepSeek Sparse Attention) decode backend. If not specified, auto-detects based on hardware and kv_cache_dtype.

--dsa-paged-mqa-logits-backend.help: DSA indexer paged MQA logits kernel backend. Options: 'auto' (default; DeepGEMM on CUDA, aiter on ROCm), 'deepgemm', 'cutedsl' (CuTe DSL kernel, SM 100 (Blackwell) only; wins at low batch size and long context), 'aiter' (ROCm only).

--dsa-prefill-backend.help: DSA (DeepSeek Sparse Attention) prefill backend. If not specified, auto-detects based on hardware and kv_cache_dtype.

--dsa-topk-backend.help: DSA indexer top-k backend for the target model. Options: 'sgl-kernel', 'torch', 'flashinfer'. The 'torch' backend currently requires SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_TOPK=false.

--dsa-triton-union.help: Union group size for --dsa-prefill-backend triton_sparse_mla: 0 disables, 2 or 4 make G adjacent query tokens share one gathered index set (mathematically exact; an ownership mask restores each token's own softmax support).

--dsv4-attn-backend.help: DeepSeek V4 attention backend. 'auto' (default) resolves to 'flashmla'. 'trtllm' (opt-in, SM100/SM103 with FP8 KV cache) switches the SWA/compressed KV pools to a uniform 512-dim FP8 layout and runs decode and sparse prefill through the ...

--dsv4-prefill-backend.help: DeepSeek-V4 sparse prefill backend. 'auto' and 'flashmla_sparse' use the existing BF16 sparse prefill path; 'flashmla_sparse_q8' enables the Q8KV8 sparse prefill path.

--dtype.help: Data type for model weights and activations. * "auto" will use FP16 precision for FP32 and FP16 models, and BF16 precision for BF16 models. * "half" for FP16. Recommended for AWQ quantization. * "float16" is the same as "half". * "bfloat...

--dwdp-size.help: DWDP (Distributed Weight Data Parallelism) group size. When > 1, MoE prefill uses weight prefetch instead of token all-to-all. Must equal tp_size. Only supported with --disaggregation-mode null or prefill.

--dynamic-batch-tokenizer-batch-size.help: [Only used if --enable-dynamic-batch-tokenizer is set] Maximum batch size for dynamic batch tokenizer.

--dynamic-batch-tokenizer-batch-timeout.help: [Only used if --enable-dynamic-batch-tokenizer is set] Timeout in seconds for batching tokenization requests.

--elastic-ep-backend.help: Specify the collective communication backend for elastic EP. Supports 'mooncake' and 'nixl'.

--elastic-ep-initial-size.help: EP size used to define the immutable per-rank expert storage layout. Scale joiners must use the primary deployment's launch-time EP size.

--elastic-ep-join-mode.help: Join mode for elastic EP. 'recover' rejoins an existing slot after a fault. 'scale' joins as a new rank beyond the original group size and requires --node-rank 1.

--elastic-ep-join-rank-offset.help: Global rank offset of an elastic EP joining group. Scale joiners must set this to the current effective EP size.

--elastic-ep-scale-timeout.help: Timeout in seconds for a pending elastic EP scale operation.

--enable-adaptive-dispatch-to-encoder.help: When enabled, adaptively dispatch: multi-image requests go to encoder in language_only epd mode, single-image requests are processed locally.

--enable-attn-tp-input-scattered.help: Allow input of attention to be scattered when only using tensor parallelism, to reduce the computational load of operations such as qkv latent.

--enable-broadcast-mm-inputs-process.help: Enable broadcast mm-inputs process in scheduler.

--enable-cache-report.help: Return number of cached tokens in usage.prompt_tokens_details for each openai request.

--enable-cp-decode-attn-tp.help: Enable attention tensor-parallel weight slicing during decode under context parallel (cp_size>1). Slices the replicated attention linears to the local CP partition, eliminating redundant decode GEMMs.

--enable-cudagraph-gc.help: Enable garbage collection during CUDA graph capture. If disabled (default), GC is frozen during capture to speed up the process.

--enable-custom-logit-processor.help: Enable users to pass custom logit processors to the server (disabled by default for security)

--enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay.help: DeepSeek-V4.1 decoder SWA bounded replay: after the last kv_source layer, run the remaining layers over only the last window_size tokens of a prefill. Main and indexer KV stay exact; nothing is replayed. Deterministic for a fixed prompt ...

--enable-deepseek-v4-fp4-indexer.help: Enable the experimental FP4 C4 indexer path for DeepSeek V4. Default keeps the existing indexer implementation.

--enable-dense-mlp-attn-tp.help: Shard dense MLP weights across the attention TP group under DP attention.

--enable-deterministic-inference.help: Enable deterministic inference mode with batch invariant ops.

--enable-dp-attention-local-control-broa.help: With DP-attention, send control messages to every DP group leader and broadcast within attn_tp_group instead of the full tp_group. Eliminates a costly all-ranks gloo sync on every scheduler iteration.

--enable-dp-lm-head.help: Enable vocabulary parallel across the attention TP group to avoid all-gather across DP groups, optimizing performance under DP attention.

--enable-draft-weights-cpu-backup.help: Save draft model weights to CPU memory during release_weights_occupation and resume_weights_occupation

--enable-dsa-cache-layer-split.help: Split DSA (DeepSeek Sparse Attention) GPU KV/indexer cache layers across context-parallel ranks to reduce per-rank KV memory. Currently only supported with the mooncake transfer backend (mooncake / mooncake_tcp); mori/nixl support will b...

--enable-dsa-fused-indexer.help: Use the four-kernel fused DSA indexer decode path in place of the 12-launch aiter/torch chain. By default this is enabled wherever it is supported -- gfx950 (MI355X) with aiter preshuffle and an fp8 e4m3fn index cache -- and the runtime ...

--enable-dynamic-batch-tokenizer.help: Enable async dynamic batch tokenizer for improved performance when multiple requests arrive concurrently.

--enable-dynamic-chunking.help: Enable dynamic chunk size adjustment for pipeline parallelism. When enabled, chunk sizes are dynamically calculated based on fitted function to maintain consistent execution time across chunks.

--enable-encoder-swa-bounded-replay.help: DeepSeek-V4.1 encoder SWA bounded replay: cache Main KV and Indexer keys only, rebuild request-owned SWA windows on prefix hits. Experimental; CUDA and gfx950.

--enable-flashinfer-allreduce-fusion.help: (Deprecated: use --flashinfer-allreduce-fusion-backend=auto) Enable FlashInfer allreduce fusion with Residual RMSNorm.

--enable-flexkv.help: Route the default RadixCache through FlexKV's KVManager for host-tier (CPU / SSD / Remote) KV cache offload. Equivalent to --radix-cache-backend=flexkv but also participates in the auto-selection chain alongside --enable-lmcache.

--enable-forward-pass-metrics.help: Enable per-iteration forward pass metrics via ZMQ IPC. External consumers (e.g. Dynamo planner) subscribe to the IPC endpoint exposed in server_args.forward_pass_metrics_ipc_name.

--enable-fp32-lm-head.help: If set, the LM head outputs (logits) are in FP32.

--enable-fused-moe-sum-all-reduce.help: Enable fused moe triton and sum all reduce.

--enable-fused-qk-norm-rope.help: Enable fused qk normalization and rope rotary embedding.

--enable-http2.help: Use Granian instead of Uvicorn as the ASGI server, enabling HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 auto-negotiation. Clients may use h2c (cleartext HTTP/2) or plain HTTP/1.1. Requires 'pip install sglang[http2]'.

--enable-int8-mamba-checkpoint.help: Store radix-cached linear-attn (mamba) states in int8 (separate checkpoint pool) for ~2x cached-prefix capacity at fixed memory.

--enable-kv-cache-sharding.help: Shard at-rest KV cache storage at page granularity across the group that currently replicates it (attention-CP ranks for GQA models under prefill CP; attention-TP ranks for MLA models), multiplying the group's unique KV capacity. Prefill...

--enable-layernorm-sp.help: Enable Megatron-style sequence parallelism (arXiv:2205.05198) for the LayerNorm/residual regions under pure tensor parallelism: the row-parallel all-reduce becomes reduce-scatter + all-gather, so LayerNorm runs on sequence-sharded activa...

--enable-layerwise-nvtx-marker.help: Enable layerwise NVTX profiling annotations for the model.

--enable-lean-attention.help: Enable Lean (Work-Centric) Attention decode kernel for long-context serving. When None (default), uses auto-gate that activates Lean for long contexts and falls back to standard kernel for short contexts. Set to True to force enable, Fal...

--enable-linear-replayssm.help: Enable the ReplaySSM buffered output-only linear-attn decode kernel. Primarily a GDN (scalar-gate) decode-bandwidth optimization (~1.2-1.5x at batch >= 64). KDA uses its selected Triton or Helion implementation, but its per-K gate ring i...

--enable-linear-replayssm-spec.help: Enable the ReplaySSM spec-verify: fold-every-commit -- a per-slot raw-input window replaces the recurrent verify's per-draft full-state snapshots. GDN or KDA hybrid linear-attn models, linear-chain (--speculative-eagle-topk in {None, 1})...

--enable-linker-mla-dedup.help: Load replicated MLA KV on rank 0 and broadcast each layer with the Mooncake linker.

--enable-lmcache.help: Using LMCache as an alternative hierarchical cache solution

--enable-lora.help: Enable LoRA support for the model. This argument is automatically set to True if `--lora-paths` is provided for backward compatibility.

--enable-lora-overlap-loading.help: Enable asynchronous LoRA weight loading in order to overlap H2D transfers with GPU compute. This should be enabled if you find that your LoRA workloads are bottlenecked by adapter weight loading, for example when frequently loading large...

--enable-mamba-cache-stochastic-rounding.help: Enable stochastic rounding when writing FP16 Mamba SSM cache states. Requires --mamba-ssm-dtype float16 and CUDA. With --mamba-backend triton, requires SM100.

--enable-memory-saver.help: Allow saving memory using release_memory_occupation and resume_memory_occupation

--enable-metrics-for-all-schedulers.help: Enable --enable-metrics-for-all-schedulers when you want schedulers on all TP ranks (not just TP 0) to record request metrics separately. This is especially useful when dp_attention is enabled, as otherwise all metrics appear to come fro...

--enable-mis.help: Enable Multi-Item Scoring optimization. Combines query and multiple items into a single sequence for efficient batch processing. Requires --attention-backend flashinfer; auto-disables CUDA graph, radix cache, and chunked prefill.

--enable-mixed-chunk.help: Enabling mixing prefill and decode in a batch when using chunked prefill.

--enable-mm-global-cache.help: Enable global multimodal embedding cache to skip redundant ViT inference.

--enable-mscclpp.help: Enable MSCCL++ for tuned AllReduce and AllGather messages, with NCCL fallback.

--enable-multimodal.help: Enable the multimodal functionality for the served model. If the model being served is not multimodal, nothing will happen

--enable-nccl-nvls.help: Enable NCCL NVLS for prefill heavy requests when available.

--enable-p2p-check.help: Enable P2P check for GPU access, otherwise the p2p access is allowed by default.

--enable-page-major-kv-layout.help: Store the Mamba state and full/SWA KV caches as one entry per token slot, holding every layer's state, in a single page-granular buffer instead of one buffer per layer. Implied by --enable-unified-memory, and currently supported only wit...

--enable-pd-role-switch.help: Allow runtime prefill<->decode role switch via /pd_role_switch (PD mode).

--enable-pdmux.help: Enable PD-Multiplexing, PD running on greenctx stream.

--enable-precise-embedding-interpolation.help: Enable corner alignment for resize of embeddings grid to ensure more accurate(but slower) evaluation of interpolated embedding values.

--enable-prefill-cp.help: Enable context parallelism for the prefill phase. Select the layout with --cp-strategy.

--enable-prefill-delayer.help: Enable prefill delayer for DP attention to reduce idle time.

--enable-prefix-mm-cache.help: Enable prefix multimodal cache. Currently only supports mm-only.

--enable-priority-scheduling.help: Enable priority scheduling. Requests with higher priority integer values will be scheduled first by default.

--enable-profile-cuda-graph.help: Enable profiling of cuda graph capture.

--enable-quant-communications.help: Enable INT8 quantization of TP communications (limited support).

--enable-request-time-stats-logging.help: Enable per request time stats logging

--enable-response-store.help: Enable in-memory Responses storage for retrieval, chaining, and background requests. Disabled by default; unsupported with prefill-decode disaggregation. Storage has no TTL or size limit.

--enable-return-hidden-states.help: Enable returning full hidden states with responses. Equivalent to `--return-hidden-states-mode full`.

--enable-return-indexer-topk.help: Enable returning indexer topk indices of layers with indexer with responses.

--enable-return-routed-experts.help: Enable returning routed experts of each layer with responses.

--enable-scattered-sconv.help: Inkling: replace the attention/MLP output all-reduce with a hidden-dimension reduce-scatter, run the channelwise output short convolution on the [T, H/P] shard, then all-gather before the residual add. This shards the convolution cache a...

--enable-session-radix-cache.help: Track per-session references on UnifiedRadixCache KV: eviction consumes unreferenced entries before referenced ones, and closing a session only dereferences its KV.

--enable-shared-experts-attn-tp.help: Shard shared expert weights across the attention TP group when using an expert-parallel all-to-all backend.

--enable-single-batch-overlap.help: Let computation and communication overlap within one micro batch.

--enable-ssl-refresh.help: Enable automatic SSL certificate hot-reloading when cert/key files change on disk. Requires --ssl-certfile and --ssl-keyfile.

--enable-streaming-session.help: Enable streaming session mode and StreamingSession wrapper.

--enable-strict-thinking.help: Enable strict token filtering during the thinking phase. Blocks model-specific excluded tokens (e.g., tool call markers) during reasoning. Requires a grammar backend that supports token filtering.

--enable-symm-mem.help: Enable NCCL symmetric memory for fast collectives.

--enable-tf32-matmul.help: Enable float32 matmuls to use TensorFloat32 precision for better performance (via torch.set_float32_matmul_precision). CUDA only.

--enable-tokenizer-batch-encode.help: Enable batch tokenization for improved performance when processing multiple text inputs. Do not use with image inputs, pre-tokenized input_ids, or input_embeds.

--enable-torch-compile.help: Optimize the model with torch.compile. Experimental feature.

--enable-torch-compile-debug-mode.help: Enable debug mode for torch compile

--priority-scheduling-preemption-thresho.help: Minimum difference in priorities for an incoming request to have to preempt running request(s).

--prompt-tokens-buckets.help: The buckets rule of prompt tokens. Supports 3 rule types: 'default' uses predefined buckets; 'tse <middle> <base> <count>' generates two sides exponential distributed buckets (e.g., 'tse 1000 2 8' generates buckets [984.0, 992.0, 996.0, ...

--qsa-indexer-dtype.help: Storage dtype of the compressed QSA indexer cache and index query (Qwen4-Exp). "fp8_e4m3" stores them as plain e4m3 and scores blocks with fp8 GEMMs (CUDA SM90+). The main KV cache is unaffected.

--quantization-param-path.help: Path to the JSON file containing the KV cache scaling factors. This should generally be supplied, when KV cache dtype is FP8. Otherwise, KV cache scaling factors default to 1.0, which may cause accuracy issues.

--quantize-and-serve.help: Quantize the model with ModelOpt and immediately serve it without exporting. This is useful for development and prototyping. For production, it's recommended to use separate quantization and deployment steps.

--radix-cache-backend.help: Name of a radix-cache backend previously registered via register_radix_cache_backend. Omit this flag to use the built-in default cache selection chain.

--radix-eviction-policy.help: The eviction policy of radix trees. 'lru' stands for Least Recently Used, 'lfu' stands for Least Frequently Used, 'slru' stands for Segmented Least Recently Used, 'priority' evicts lower-priority requests first, and 'tlru' stands for Tai...

--radix-eviction-policy-config.help: Tuning parameters for --radix-eviction-policy, as a json object passed to the policy as keyword arguments. 'slru' takes protected_threshold (int, default 2), e.g. '{"protected_threshold": 4}'; 'tlru' takes threshold and next_prompt_estim...

--remote-instance-weight-loader-backend.help: The backend for loading weights from remote instance. Can be 'transfer_engine', 'nccl', or 'modelexpress'. Default is 'nccl'.

--remote-instance-weight-loader-seed-ins.help: The ip of the seed instance for loading weights from remote instance.
The service port of the seed instance for loading weights from remote instance.

--remote-instance-weight-loader-send-wei.help: The communication group ports for loading weights from remote instance.

--remote-instance-weight-loader-start-se.help: Start seed server via transfer engine backend for remote instance weight loader.

--retraction-policy.help: The decode retraction policy to use when the KV cache is full. 'length' preserves the existing behavior and retracts short-output, long-input requests first. 'priority' retracts lower-priority requests first, using the same priority dire...

--return-hidden-states-mode.help: Set the maximum hidden-state return mode supported by the server. `last` allows requests with return_hidden_states=False or `last`; `full` also allows return_hidden_states=True.

--return-input-ids.help: Return prompt (input) token ids on the response-level sglext extension for every chat completion request, as if return_input_ids_in_sglext were set on the request.

--return-output-ids.help: Return sampled output token ids on the response-level sglext extension for every chat completion request, as if return_output_ids_in_sglext were set on the request.

--revision.help: The specific model version to use. It can be a branch name, a tag name, or a commit id. If unspecified, will use the default version.

--rl-on-policy-target.help: The training system that SGLang needs to match for true on-policy.

--rl-quant-profile.help: Path to the FlashRL quantization profile. Required when using --load-format flash_rl.

--sampling-backend.help: Choose the kernels for sampling layers.

--sampling-defaults.help: Where to get default sampling parameters. 'openai' uses SGLang/OpenAI defaults (temperature=1.0, top_p=1.0, etc.). 'model' uses the model's generation_config.json to get the recommended sampling parameters if available. Default is 'model'.

--sampling-mask-max-tokens.help: The maximum number of token IDs in a returned sampling mask. Requests are aborted if their realized sampling support exceeds this limit. Use the same value on disaggregated prefill and decode nodes; clients should set top_k below the lim...

--schedule-conservativeness.help: How conservative the schedule policy is. A larger value means more conservative scheduling. Use a larger value if you see requests being retracted frequently.

--schedule-low-priority-values-first.help: If specified with --enable-priority-scheduling, the scheduler will schedule requests with lower priority integer values first.

--schedule-policy.help: The scheduling policy of the requests.

--scheduler-recv-interval.help: The interval to poll requests in scheduler. Can be set to >1 to reduce the overhead of this.

--served-model-name.help: Override the model name returned by the v1/models endpoint in OpenAI API server.

--shared-experts-tp-size.help: Shared-expert TP size for Kimi-K3 with an expert-parallel all-to-all backend. Must divide attention TP size. Overrides --enable-shared-experts-attn-tp when set; 1 replicates the weights.

--show-time-cost.help: Show time cost of custom marks.

--sidecar.help: Start a locally managed sidecar against the native gRPC server. The selected module must expose main(argv) and read the resolved native gRPC endpoint from SGLANG_GRPC_ENDPOINT. Requires --grpc-port or SGLANG_GRPC_PORT.

--sidecar-args.help: JSON array passed to the selected sidecar module's main(argv) function. --sidecar-shutdown-timeout SECONDS is consumed by SGLang.

--skip-tokenizer-init.help: If set, skip init tokenizer and pass input_ids in generate request.

--sleep-on-idle.help: Reduce CPU usage when sglang is idle.

--smg-grpc-mode.help: Use the legacy SMG gRPC server (smg-grpc-servicer) instead of the HTTP server. Replaces the deprecated --grpc-mode.

--smg-http-sidecar-port.help: Port for the HTTP sidecar server in legacy SMG gRPC mode (--smg-grpc-mode). Serves Prometheus metrics and profiling endpoints. Defaults to --port + 1. Not used in HTTP mode.

--soft-watchdog-timeout.help: Set soft watchdog timeout in seconds. If a forward batch takes longer than this, the server will dump information for debugging.

--spec-trace-dir.help: Directory to write decoupled speculative decoding trace files.

--speculative-accept-threshold-acc.help: The accept probability of a draft token is raised from its target probability p to min(1, p / threshold_acc).

--speculative-accept-threshold-single.help: Accept a draft token if its probability in the target model is greater than this threshold.

--speculative-adaptive.help: Enable adaptive speculative decoding that dynamically adjusts num_steps based on acceptance rate.

--speculative-adaptive-config.help: Path to a JSON config file for adaptive speculative decoding tuning knobs.

--speculative-algorithm.help: Speculative algorithm. Builtins: EAGLE, EAGLE3, NEXTN, STANDALONE, NGRAM, DFLASH, DSPARK, UNO. Or any name registered via `SpeculativeAlgorithm.register`.

--speculative-attention-mode.help: Attention backend for speculative decoding operations (both target verify and draft extend). Can be one of 'prefill' (default) or 'decode'.

--speculative-dflash-block-size.help: DFLASH only. Block size (verify window length). Alias of --speculative-num-draft-tokens for DFLASH.

--speculative-domino-candidate-pool-size.help: Domino only. Size of the approximate block-shared base-logit candidate pool. Set to 0 to score the full vocabulary.

--speculative-draft-attention-backend.help: Attention backend for speculative decoding drafting.

--speculative-draft-kv-cache-dtype.help: KV cache dtype for the speculative draft model only. The draft pool is allocated with one slot per target token (draft and target share a slot index space), so for a small draft it can still rival the target pool: a 5-layer DFLASH draft ...

--speculative-draft-load-format.help: The format of the draft model weights to load. If not specified, will use the same format as --load-format. Use 'dummy' to initialize draft model weights with random values for profiling.

--speculative-draft-model-path.help: The path of the draft model weights. This can be a local folder or a Hugging Face repo ID.

--speculative-draft-model-quantization.help: The quantization method for speculative model.

--speculative-draft-model-revision.help: The specific draft model version to use. It can be a branch name, a tag name, or a commit id. If unspecified, will use the default version.

--speculative-draft-sink-size.help: Number of leading 'attention sink' tokens the draft always attends to, in addition to the --speculative-draft-window-size recent window (StreamingLLM-style). Honored only by the built-in EAGLE/MTP draft-decode path on the Triton and Flas...

--speculative-draft-window-size.help: Sliding window size for the draft model. Honored by Llama EAGLE-3 (`LlamaForCausalLMEagle3`), DFLASH, and the built-in EAGLE/MTP draft-decode path on the Triton and FlashInfer draft backends; other EAGLE-3 backends (e.g. MLA-based drafte...

--speculative-dsa-topk-backend.help: DSA indexer top-k backend for speculative draft workers. Options: 'sgl-kernel', 'torch', 'flashinfer'. The 'torch' backend currently requires SGLANG_DSA_FUSE_TOPK=false.

--speculative-dspark-align-verify-tokens.help: DSPARK compact ragged-verify only. Fill the per-request verify lengths so the total verify-token count reaches the cuda-graph tier the forward is already padded to: round the dp-max scheduled total up to the captured token bucket and let...

--speculative-dspark-block-size.help: DSPARK only. Draft block size gamma (number of proposed draft tokens). The verify window is gamma + 1, so this sets --speculative-num-draft-tokens = gamma + 1. Omit to auto-infer gamma from the draft checkpoint block_size.

--speculative-dspark-confidence-sts-path.help: DSPARK only. Optional path to a per-position STS (sequential temperature scaling) calibration JSON, fit offline with sglang.benchmark.dspark_sts_fit. Calibrates the confidence-head survival probabilities the ragged-verify scheduler consu...

--speculative-dspark-sps-table-path.help: DSPARK only. Path to a pre-profiled SPS cost table (JSON) built offline with sglang.benchmark.dspark_sps_profiler, consumed by the ragged-verify scheduler (cap-accept / compact). Omit for an uninitialized flat constant-SPS table: the bud...

--speculative-eagle-topk.help: The number of tokens sampled from the draft model in eagle2 each step.

--speculative-enable-w4a4-mxfp4-megamoe.help: Whether the draft model's MXFP4 MegaMoE layers use the W4A4 mxf4xmxf4 MMA type (see --enable-w4a4-mxfp4-megamoe). Pass --no-speculative-enable-w4a4-mxfp4-megamoe to keep the draft on fp8xfp4 (W4A8) while the target runs W4A4. Same as --e...

--speculative-moe-a2a-backend.help: Choose the backend for MoE A2A in speculative decoding. Defaults to --moe-a2a-backend, except flashinfer_megamoe defaults the draft to none (draft layers are typically unquantized, which flashinfer_megamoe's global-expert-id dispatch doe...

--speculative-moe-runner-backend.help: Choose the runner backend for MoE in speculative decoding. Defaults to --moe-runner-backend, except flashinfer_megamoe defaults the draft to flashinfer_trtllm (draft layers are typically unquantized, which flashinfer_megamoe's global-exp...

--speculative-ngram-capacity.help: The cache capacity for ngram speculative decoding.

--speculative-ngram-external-corpus-max-.help: Fail startup if the tokenized external ngram corpus exceeds this many tokens. Tune this based on your CPU memory budget.

--speculative-ngram-external-corpus-path.help: Path to an external JSONL corpus to pre-load into SAM at startup. Additional corpora can be added at runtime via POST /add_external_corpus.

--speculative-ngram-external-sam-budget.help: Number of draft nodes reserved for the external SAM subtree in ngram speculative decoding.

--speculative-ngram-match-type.help: The match type for cache tree.

--speculative-ngram-max-bfs-breadth.help: The maximum breadth for BFS (Breadth-First Search) in ngram speculative decoding.

--speculative-ngram-max-trie-depth.help: The max trie depth for ngram speculative decoding.

--speculative-ngram-min-bfs-breadth.help: The minimum breadth for BFS (Breadth-First Search) in ngram speculative decoding.

--speculative-num-draft-tokens.help: The number of tokens sampled from the draft model in Speculative Decoding.

--speculative-num-steps.help: The number of steps sampled from draft model in Speculative Decoding.

--speculative-skip-dp-mlp-sync.help: Skip the extra MLP sync that the scheduler performs before merging a new batch when speculative decoding + DP attention are both enabled.

--speculative-token-map.help: The path of the draft model's small vocab table.

--speculative-use-block-verification.help: Use block verification for EAGLE/EAGLE3/NEXTN (requires topk=1) or for sampled DFLASH/DSPARK drafts, on CUDA or ROCm.

--speculative-use-rejection-sampling.help: Use rejection sampling for speculative decoding (requires topk=1).

--ssl-certfile.help: The file path to the SSL certificate file.

--ssl-keyfile.help: The file path to the SSL key file.

--ssl-keyfile-password.help: The password to decrypt the SSL keyfile.

--startup-weight-load-mode.help: Control startup weight loading relative to CUDA graph capture. 'serial' preserves the existing startup order; 'overlap' stages checkpoint files while CUDA graphs are captured and commits the real weights afterward.

--stream-interval.help: The interval (or buffer size) for streaming in terms of the token length. A smaller value makes streaming smoother, while a larger value makes the throughput higher

--stream-response-default-include-usage.help: Include usage in every streaming response (even when stream_options is not specified).

--strip-thinking-cache.help: Skip caching reasoning-model output (thinking + answer) in the radix tree on finish; keep only the prompt prefix. Opt-in: changes cache contents.

--swa-full-tokens-ratio.help: The ratio of SWA layer KV tokens / full layer KV tokens, regardless of the number of swa:full layers. It should be between 0 and 1. E.g. 0.5 means if each swa layer has 50 tokens, then each full layer has 100 tokens.

--swa-prefix-tails.help: When the SWA KV pool is sized from the request cap (DeepSeek-V4 family), how many radix-cached prefix tails it keeps room for. Each tail is one sliding window plus one page. Default: 4 x max_running_requests per attention-DP rank, 0 when...

--tbo-token-distribution-threshold.help: The threshold of token distribution between two batches in micro-batch-overlap, determines whether to two-batch-overlap or two-chunk-overlap. Set to 0 denote disable two-chunk-overlap.

--tokenizer-backend.help: Tokenizer backend. 'huggingface' uses the default HuggingFace tokenizers library, and 'fastokens' uses the fastokens library for faster tokenization. Requires the fastokens package to be installed.

--tokenizer-metrics-allowed-custom-label.help: The custom labels allowed for tokenizer metrics. The labels are specified via a dict in '--tokenizer-metrics-custom-labels-header' field in HTTP requests, e.g., {'label1': 'value1', 'label2': 'value2'} is allowed if '--tokenizer-metrics-...

--tokenizer-metrics-custom-labels-header.help: Specify the HTTP header for passing custom labels for tokenizer metrics.

--tokenizer-mode.help: Tokenizer mode. 'auto' will use the fast tokenizer if available, and 'slow' will always use the slow tokenizer.

--tokenizer-worker-num.help: The worker num of the tokenizer manager.

--tool-server.help: Either 'demo' or a comma-separated list of tool server urls to use for the model. If not specified, no tool server will be used.

--torch-compile-max-bs.help: Set the maximum batch size when using torch compile.

--trace-modules.help: Select the components to trace. Available options are 'request' and 'mooncake'. Format: <module1 name>,<module2 name>,...

--triton-attention-num-kv-splits.help: The number of KV splits in flash decoding Triton kernel. Larger value is better in longer context scenarios. The default value is 8.

--triton-attention-reduce-in-fp32.help: Cast the intermediate attention results to fp32 to avoid possible crashes related to fp16.This only affects Triton attention kernels.

--triton-attention-split-tile-size.help: The size of split KV tile in flash decoding Triton kernel. Used for deterministic inference.

--trust-mm-content-hashes.help: Trust caller-provided multimodal SHA-256 content hashes. This can skip reading media on a hot metadata-cache hit; only enable it when the caller guarantees that hashes identify immutable media bytes.

--trust-remote-code.help: Whether or not to allow for custom models defined on the Hub in their own modeling files.

--trust-request-chat-template.help: Allow a request to override the server chat template via its chat_template_kwargs. Off by default for safety.

--uno-lora-path.help: Path to the UNO draft LoRA checkpoint.

--use-ray.help: Use Ray actors for scheduler process management.

--uvicorn-access-log-exclude-prefixes.help: Exclude uvicorn access logs whose request path starts with any of these prefixes. Defaults to empty (disabled). Example: --uvicorn-access-log-exclude-prefixes /metrics /health

--warmups.help: Specify custom warmup functions (csv) to run before server starts eg. --warmups=warmup_name1,warmup_name2 will run the functions `warmup_name1` and `warmup_name2` specified in warmup.py before the server starts listening for requests

--watchdog-timeout.help: Set watchdog timeout in seconds. If a forward batch takes longer than this, the server will crash to prevent hanging.

--watermark-config.help: Watermark settings as a JSON file path or an inline JSON object with optional key, key_b, context_window, mixing_probability, max_probability, default_enabled, and enforce_all fields.

--weight-cache-mode.help: Weight cache mode. 'off': normal disk loading. 'daemon': launch weight cache daemon (holds weights in GPU memory). Engine-spawned daemons are co-terminal with the engine and do NOT persist across restarts, so this alone does not speed up...

--weight-cache-socket.help: Unix socket path for weight cache daemon (client mode).If not set, derives the path from SGLANG_WEIGHT_CACHE_SOCKET_TEMPLATE using the caller's physical GPU UUID.

--weight-cache-timeout.help: Timeout in seconds for weight cache daemon readiness (default: 1800).

--weight-loader-disable-mmap.help: Disable mmap while loading weight using safetensors.

--weight-loader-drop-cache-after-load.help: Call posix_fadvise(DONTNEED) on each safetensors shard after loading it.

--weight-loader-prefetch-checkpoints.help: Prefetch checkpoint files into OS page cache before loading. Each rank prefetches a fraction of the shards, reducing total network I/O on shared filesystems (NFS/Lustre) from N*checkpoint to 1*checkpoint. Recommended for models on networ...

--weight-loader-prefetch-num-threads.help: Number of threads per rank for checkpoint prefetching (default: 4).

--weight-version.help: Version identifier for the model weights. Defaults to 'default' if not specified.
